activation.entry_rule: At the first fresh observed qualifying IBKR RTH quote, SPY must be at or above 744.99, SSO must not be halted, and SSO bid-ask spread must be at or below 0.15 percent.
activation.exact_open_handling: If the exact 09:30:00 ET quote is not observed, use the first observed qualifying RTH ask and label FIRST_OBSERVED_NOT_OFFICIAL_OPEN.
activation.pending_reason: The validated research signal occurred on the 2026-07-31 completed close. Current observations are Sunday overnight and cannot be recorded as the RTH entry.

invalidation.primary: SPY completed RTH close below the then-current SMA50
invalidation.pre_entry_cancel: At the first fresh RTH observation SPY is below 744.99, SSO is halted, spread exceeds 0.15 percent, or reliable IBKR data are unavailable.

data_policy.parity: Alpaca when required by confidence policy
